continuation.text:
I made no changes to `src/solution.py`, and I didn't run it or write any checks.

The existing `is_allocation_feasible` already meets the current requirements:
- It returns `False` if a request asks for an unknown resource, or if total demand for any resource exceeds its capacity.
- It also returns `False` when every resource is used up exactly. It returns `True` only if at least one resource still has some left over.

I read "at least one resource must remain unallocated" as at least one resource type having leftover capacity. The code and the requirement are both open to that reading, so I kept it. The existing input validation (non-dict inputs, non-numeric or negative amounts) is unrelated to this requirement, so I left it alone.
